text:
You need a 3D artist who can take AI-generated assets and finish the last mile so they match the creative vision and technical requirements of GenieLabs’ product.

I’m Noor Halden, and while my background is in machine learning rather than 3D art, I’m very familiar with the workflow of refining model outputs into production-ready results and collaborating closely with technical teams to improve quality, consistency, and usability. I have 6 years of experience working with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, and I’m comfortable working in fast-moving environments where iteration with a CTO or product team matters.

On the product recommendations project for Tidewater Outfitters, I built similar items and you-may-also-like carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached in Redis. That work improved click-through rate by 14% in a 4-week A/B test. The key part of that engagement was turning model output into something reliable and useful in production, with attention to performance and integration details.

On the telecom churn prediction project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read. That model reached an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and a top-decile lift of 3.1x. This project reinforced how important it is to make generated or predicted outputs interpretable, consistent, and aligned with real operational needs.

For GenieLabs, I would bring the same disciplined approach to working with generated 3D assets: refining outputs, improving consistency, and collaborating closely with the CTO to optimize assets for the final product. I’m especially interested in teams building with cutting-edge AI systems, and I’d be excited to help develop new tools and techniques that improve the quality and reliability of the asset pipeline.

If helpful, I’d be glad to discuss how I’d approach the review-and-refinement process and where I can contribute most effectively alongside your team.
